title: Anomaly Score Aggregation Analysis
key_diagnostic_answer: The reconstruction error itself is largely non-discriminative. Alternative score aggregations (Max Feature Error, Top-K, and Temporal Persistence) fail to elevate Scope ROC-AUC (0.470-0.505) substantially above random chance (0.500). Per-feature analysis reveals that during verified attacks, reconstruction errors on compromised features do not consistently exceed normal operational errors, demonstrating that the autoencoder bottleneck has memorized normal variability while remaining unable to separate cyber-physical perturbations from baseline noise.
